payout_quote: As soon as jobs are available, you can browse and book shifts directly through the app— at your convenience.
steps: Download the free Indeed Flex app and create your profile.
Get verified for the roles you want to work.
Browse shifts near you — pay rates are shown before you book.
Book shifts instantly that fit your schedule.
Complete the shift and choose Same Day Pay to access earnings as soon as you finish.
catches: Shift availability varies by city and season — new markets may have little work.
Pay rates are set per shift; you cannot negotiate them.
Verification for roles takes time before you can book.
Physical shift work (warehouse, hospitality, cleaning) with real injury/fatigue risk.
You are responsible for transport and taxes; benefits depend on the market.
biggest_catch: Work is not guaranteed: you can only book shifts that exist in your area, and rates are take-it-or-leave-it per listing.
eligibility: 18+ (typical) with a smartphone; must pass role verification.
timing: Shifts post daily; Same Day Pay available after shifts.
